note: Inherits build 57 unchanged; build 58 only regresses and fixes it (ADR-0010).

rule.en: Third-party platforms own orders, delivery and after-sales; never promise a ticket or a room.
rule.zh: 第三方平台负责订单、交付和售后；不承诺票和房。

upto.en: Information and hand-off prepared (plan, roadbook, cards, links).
upto.zh: 准备完成：行程、路书、出示卡、跳转链接。

evidence.en: What the user can see in the app.
evidence.zh: 用户在 App 里看到的内容。
